newsitem.title: CHINA: China Construction FRN upped to US$70 mln.
newsitem.headline: China Construction FRN upped to US$70 mln.

text.p: China Construction Holdings Ltd's floating rate notes issue due 2004 has been increased to US$70 million from US$60 million after being oversubscribed, arranger LTCB Asia said.
The seven-year notes have put and call options on the fifth anniversary. They were priced at par to float at 210 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 230 basis points.
Arrangers, with US$8 million each, are LTCB Asia and Union Bank of Switzerland's Hongkong branch.
Co-arranger/lead managers, with US$8 million each, are Bear Stearns Asia and Peregrine Fixed Income.
Co-lead managers, with US$5 million each, are Korean French Banking Corp, Kyungki Bank, Oversea-Chinese Banking Corp and Seoul (Asia) Finance.

Co-managers, with US$3 million each, are Agricultural Bank of China's Hongkong branch, Hanwha Merchant Bank, Hanil Leasing Singapore Pte Ltd, KEB Leasing and Finance Ltd, KEXIM International (Singapore) and Korea Long-term Credit Bank's Tokyo branch.
